title: Chat and messaging
summary: One-to-one and small group messaging with delivery to online devices in real time.
functional: Send a message to a person or group
Deliver instantly to online devices, later to offline ones
non_functional: Delivery p99 under 300 ms between online users
Messages are never lost once acknowledged

messages_per_user_per_day.why: Active chat users send dozens of messages a day.

message_bytes.why: About 100 bytes of text plus ids, timestamps and encryption overhead.

online_fraction.why: Share of daily users connected at the same moment at peak.

connections_per_server.why: Long-lived WebSocket connections per gateway with an event loop.

retention_years.why: Server keeps undelivered and recent history for one year.

derived.name: storage_total
derived.label: Message storage for the retention period, with replicas

derived.name: peak_bandwidth
derived.label: Message bandwidth at peak (in and out)
